problem: Rename the column users.fullname to users.display_name, which the running application reads and writes
context: Web app deployed with rolling deploys, so old and new app versions run side by side for several minutes. PostgreSQL.
constraints: No downtime and no failed requests during the change

options.summary: ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN fullname TO display_name, deployed with the app change
Add display_name, dual-write both columns, backfill, switch reads, then drop fullname in a later release
Take the app offline for 10 minutes, rename the column and deploy the new version

criteria.description: No errors or downtime during the rollout

expected.why: During a rolling deploy, old code breaks on a renamed column; a maintenance window violates the constraint.
